purpose: Curated research evidence embedded by knowledge_search; not executable policy or proof of current-world behavior.

records.subject: altar zones
records.statement: The pinned framework describes altar zones as half-open boxes of half-metre cells. This differs from inclusive capture corners.
records.next_test: Compare exact zone-edge points and capture endpoints around a test altar; test metre-to-cell conversion at both boundaries.

records.subject: recipe classification
records.statement: RecipeView::kind can be unavailable before its output item loads; the documented first dedicated-server registry build can lack kinds.
records.next_test: Read a known building item's classification before and after normal item loading. Preserve unavailable separately from Other.

records.subject: progression recovery
records.statement: The framework documents that revoking knowledge does not reverse all consequences of a grant, including granted experience, chained unlocks and spent skill points.
records.next_test: First observe normal progression dependencies on a disposable character/world. Do not advertise reversible progression writes without an independent recovery test.

records.subject: placement rotation
records.statement: Keen's January 2025 update distinguishes free decorative-prop rotation, vertical-axis interactive props, and quarter-turn building shapes.
records.next_test: Reproduce allowed rotations for one current example of each category and verify interaction after placement before enforcing a planner rule.

records.subject: client feature requirements
records.statement: The pinned framework distinguishes server and both sides; both requires matching client mods. The dedicated server has no crafting UI bundle.
records.next_test: Keep server-only observation as the baseline; assess join and installation requirements in a separate test before any client extension.

records.subject: first end-to-end planning benchmark
records.statement: A compact workshop built from eligible existing stock can exercise item lookup, recipe dependencies, unlocks, inventory, layout, persistence, placement and read-back in one bounded project.

applicability.objective: functional workshop with minimal new gathering

evidence.method: project design proposal, not a game observation

records.next_test: Produce a read-only bill of materials and layout for known test-world stock, with unresolved requirements explicit, before proposing execution.

records.subject: linked inventory reads
records.statement: On an isolated dedicated server, a player inventory returned 72 linked slots; five sequential 16-slot pages matched one full quiet snapshot. A user-controlled Raw lean meat split changed exactly one item from a stack of six to stacks of one and five. One equipped item durability matched the UI at 263/319.

applicability.scope: one player, one quiet inventory, no linked chest or concurrent paging guarantee

evidence.method: real MCP reads, sequential page equality, independently reported UI values and controlled user stack split

records.next_test: Verify known chest stacks, cross-inventory eligibility, instance definitions and behavior while contents change. Reacquire all runtime identities each session.

records.subject: enemy NetworkHealth
records.statement: On an isolated dedicated server, a nearby spear-carrying enemy had NetworkHealth 64/73. After the user reported three unarmed hits and a decreased UI bar, the same session entity read 55/73. Other candidates, including the player, had explicit absent NetworkHealth states.

applicability.scope: one enemy before/after observation; not player health or complete combat simulation

evidence.method: typed MCP reads plus independent component presence and user-reported health-bar decrease

records.next_test: Compare a known full-health and damaged fixture numerically with UI. Test wider actor coverage; do not infer per-hit damage or absent health from absent NetworkHealth.
